title: EquiPy: Sequential Fairness using Optimal Transport in Python
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focused on mitigating bias related to sensitive attributes like gender and ethnicity in machine learning models.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on algorithmic fairness for demographic attributes like gender and ethnicity.
